name: Neuffen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically black and yellow, charged above the centre with the city arms of Neuffen (three black hunting horns on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Neuffen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Neuffen arms — three hunting horns on yellow
